notes.title: Demo Update 10-6-2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

The demo has been updated.

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Removal of streamer mode, feature is not really needed
[*]Added end to kill screen a retry button
[*]Updated dialogue box to be clear to hit e to continue.
[*]New cutscene dialogue
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Washed the Shower curtains and new ones aren't sticky
[*] David has been put on a strict diet and is now able to squeeze into new places.
[/list]
